items.detail: No tracked modifications (`git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no` empty; HEAD 3986b18). A live curl-only probe launched from /tmp through `auger.py api` returned: health 200 0.006757s; specs 200 0.024561s with count=12; SPEC-GRAPH-CORPUS 200 0.000861s with the full block body; namespaced check 200 2.841965s with 3 hits, jev_used=true, verdict=NOT YET ANSWERED, verdict_decided_by=score; and bare POST /check 404 with `{"error":"no such route: /check"}`. The exact historical HEAD 7a4b68d measurements (0.0052s, 0.105s/count=12, 0.0092s, 2.846s/score, control 404) are recorded at .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl:668 and commit 01e744f; docs/qa/aug172-fix-proof.md:17-28 supplies the probe recipe. The row's AC4 at .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl:272 names the registered namespaced route and explicitly rejects the bare /check alias. Retrieval/JEV timeout and UNKNOWN behavior were additionally exercised by an HTTP probe that printed BOUNDED_FAIL_CLOSED_PROBE_PASS. Focused verification: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_api_service.py` exited 0 with 9 passed; `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_openapi_parity.py` exited 0 with 11 passed.

items.criterion: The four required endpoints and the POST /check control must be reachable through the actual `auger.py api` CLI entrypoint on a live socket, with the documented response shapes and no project lookup for spec reads.
items.detail: The CLI registration at auger.py:14332-14335 dispatches to cmd_api at auger.py:7855 and serve/APIHandler at auger.py:7592. The live /tmp probe reached all four endpoints and the control with the expected status/body shapes. The specs branch at auger.py:7661-7663 returns before `_namespace(ns)` at auger.py:7665, so spec reads do not perform project lookup; tests/test_api_service.py:157-168 covers this route contract.

items.criterion: The HTTP check path must actually pass retrieval timeout=3 and JEV timeout=10, and retrieval/JEV failure must produce HTTP 200 UNKNOWN with jev_used=false and verdict_decided_by=fail-closed rather than an error or optimistic verdict.
items.detail: auger.py:7768-7770 calls `recall(..., timeout=3)` and auger.py:7790-7795 calls `jev(..., timeout=10)`; auger.py:7802-7820 selects UNKNOWN/fail-closed when no usable score exists. An actual in-process HTTP probe observed retrieval timeout 3 and JEV timeout 10, and both failure arms returned HTTP 200 with `{'verdict':'UNKNOWN','verdict_decided_by':'fail-closed','jev_used':False}`, ending with BOUNDED_FAIL_CLOSED_PROBE_PASS. The focused API suite also passed 9 tests in 3.59s.

items.criterion: The claimed HEAD 7a4b68d re-measurements and POST /check route correction must be substantiated by committed repository evidence, with docs/qa/aug172-fix-proof.md supplying the probe recipe.
items.detail: .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl:668 records the exact HEAD 7a4b68d measurements and the namespaced-check/control-404 result; commit 01e744f records the AC4 route correction and repeats the measurements. docs/qa/aug172-fix-proof.md:17-28 documents the /tmp server launch and probe procedure. The independent live probe reproduced the same count=12, block-body, score-decided check, and bare-/check 404 behavior.
